title: guarea cedrata
intro: Guarea cedrata, commonly known as Guarea, is a medicinal plant that belongs to the family Meliaceae. Guarea is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Guarea include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues, and as an anti-inflammatory agent, reducing pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents of Guarea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
